title: A write to a handoff file that drops a section the precompact prompt requires is refused or asks
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (session_013NEJL3ZjZdzrS8tBezxY85), 15:26 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: at 15:25 CST a python slice edit on its handoff cut off everything after "## Where things stand" (Work in flight, Next steps, Files and commands): the regex looked for a next "- #" line and none came. It caught it at once and rewrote the handoff from context. Today nothing checks the sections until compaction. Red case: a write that removes a required section is refused or asks.
